content.title: What Disney's OpenAI partnership could mean for ads
content.description:
Disney (DIS) will be making a $1 billion equity investment into OpenAI (OPAI.PVT), reaching an agreement to become the first major content licensing partner with the artificial intelligence firm's Sora AI video-generating platform.

MNTN (MNTN) CEO Mark Douglas reacts to this news and how this type of AI content could change the marketing landscape and how ads are used.
